main.description: Decide a subject in the review queue: take its account down, label it, or dismiss it. Closes every open report against the subject either way. A takedown is com.atproto.admin.updateSubjectStatus's, made in the same step. Requires an admin session.

subject.description: An account's bare DID, or a record's at:// URI.

label.description: The label to apply; required for the label action.
